title: The Toxic One
description: A manosphere influencer who calls his followers @[TOOLTIP_TITLE]{Venom Nation} is offering you a brand deal for your commitment to toxicity: a mystery item from his merch line, or a Pokémon from his personal collection.

1.label: Accept the Merch
